title: Power of the Holy Spirit
definition: The power of the Holy Spirit is His divine enabling for witness, holiness, endurance, service, and faithful obedience.
summary: The Spirit gives power for Christian life and mission.
christFocus: Jesus promised power from the Spirit so His people could bear witness to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit's power is not for spiritual showmanship. It is God's enabling for witness, holiness, endurance, prayer, service, love, and courage.

The Church's mission depends on the Spirit's power. Human skill, planning, and effort cannot replace Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers try to serve Christ in their own strength. This doctrine matters because Christian life and mission require divine help.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Spirit for power to witness, obey, endure, love, and serve. Do not use spiritual power language for pride or performance.

relatedTopics: Spiritual Gifts and Ministry of the Holy Spirit
